sentences.en: Space is actually a good insulator because it is difficult to transfer heat to nothing.
sentences.zh: 真空实际上是一个很好的绝缘体，因为很难将热量传递给不存在的东西。

sentences.en: The house uses thick foam boards as an insulator against the winter cold.
sentences.zh: 这房子用厚厚的泡沫板来防止冬天的寒冷。

sentences.en: To prevent electricity from escaping, we need a good insulator around the wires.
sentences.zh: 为了防止电流失走，我们需要在电线周围使用良好的绝缘体。

senses.zh: [物] 绝缘体；从事绝缘工作的工人
